description: DISCOVERED BUG (see coder-W0-S9 report, not fixed per NON-GOALS): hooks/scripts/teammate_idle.sh:57-58 calls `bin/shepherd teammate heartbeat "$TEAMMATE" --note='idle'`, but services/cli/shepherd_cli/commands/teammate.py registers only liveness/status/state -- there is no `heartbeat` @app.command(). This case freezes the CLI's ACTUAL current behavior (a Click/Typer 'no such command' usage error) as the golden oracle, since that -- not a hypothetical success path -- is the contract a Rust port must reproduce. The calling hook silently swallows this failure via `2>/dev/null || true`.
